description: Read a key. Free, no payment or identity needed, rate limited per address. Needs the box: a box_... id from put, or a channel name. Returns value null with found false if absent or expired. A box is a namespace of keys. Omit it on a paid call to use your own wallet's box (the call returns its id). Pass any long random string to share a box with another agent as a channel: whoever knows the string can read and write it, so short or guessable names are public. Pass a box_... id returned by an earlier call to address that box directly. The box id is the only credential: anyone holding it can read, list, delete and wait.
name: get
title: Get
